title: Finish the mock conform pass across all pages
notes: Objective: creation-vision > editor-surfaces (one-shell conformance). From study-tasks.json conform-pass (was in_progress when the mock loop went dormant) plus the residue of foundation-adjust. The July component rebuild (shared/components/) landed much of the shell; unknown how many of the 88 pages conform. First re-run the ux-audit clusters A-G scan (shared/ux-audit-agent.md, ux-audit-clusters.md) to find what remains, then conform in disjoint batches. Adjustment/filter layer as a first-class layer type in Layers panel + Inspector was never verified landed.
acceptance: A fresh ux-audit scan (clusters A-G) over all pages is recorded, listing exactly which pages still fail which cluster
Every failing page is conformed or has its own follow-up queue task filed
Adjustment/filter layer appears as a first-class layer type in the Layers panel and Inspector of the shell reference page, or a note explains where it landed
All touched pages return 200 and pass shared/audit-sweep.js
